title: Art
tagline: Bronzes, brush and woodblock from the Shang to the late twentieth century
hero_caption: Katsushika Hokusai, The Great Wave off Kanagawa, c. 1831
intro: The art of China, Japan and Korea from Shang ritual bronzes to the postwar avant-garde: painting and calligraphy, Buddhist sculpture, ceramics, lacquer and woodblock prints. Every artist, including the anonymous workshops behind many masterpieces, has a biography and every work a full introduction. Public-domain works are shown from Wikimedia Commons; works still under copyright link to a museum page instead.
